tubeRoles.cul: Carries the culture round its loop.
tubeRoles.pro: Carries what crossed the fiber wall, from the membrane’s shell side.
tubeRoles.koh: Carries base to the culture vessel.
tubeRoles.air: Vents the culture vessel through its air filter.

parts.name: Peristaltic pumps
parts.role: Move the culture round its loop and the protectant out.

parts.name: In‑line photometer
parts.role: Reads OD600 as the culture flows past.

parts.name: Hollow‑fiber membrane
parts.role: The cells stay in the fibers; what they secrete crosses to the shell side.

parts.name: Probes
parts.role: pH and temperature, in the vessel’s cap.

parts.name: Protectant bottle
parts.role: Collects what crosses the fiber wall.

parts.name: KOH bottle
parts.role: Base, to hold the culture’s pH.

parts.name: Servo valves
parts.role: Open and close the culture’s way through the membrane.

parts.name: Pressure sensors
parts.role: Four, one at each membrane port.

parts.name: Outlet
parts.role: Where the protectant leaves for the field.

parts.name: Stopcocks
parts.role: Taps on the sensor and shell lines.

parts.name: Sampler
parts.role: Draws a culture sample without opening the loop.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.role: Perforated; the bottles stand on it.

parts.name: Door
parts.role: Smoked glass; opened only by our team.

parts.name: Top panel and handle
parts.role: The cabinet’s lid, with the handle it is carried by.

parts.name: Side and end panels
parts.role: Close the cabinet around the modules.

parts.name: Frame
parts.role: Posts and rails that carry the panels.
